content.short: Kintsu is a liquid staking protocol operating on Monad and Hyperliquid.
content.description: Kintsu brings staking, lending and curated vaults onto one capital layer spanning Canton, Monad and Hyperliquid. Holders of eligible tokenized assets can post them as collateral and borrow variable-rate liquidity privately while keeping their underlying exposure. Capital can instead be allocated into vaults, or a manager can turn market expertise into a product by launching a market of their own. Execution is privacy-preserving, built on what the team describes as a programmable risk operating system for institutional users.
content.meta: Liquid staking deployed on both Monad and Hyperliquid, sharing one integration surface.
